name: kandle-mcp
description: Lets an agent read and draw on a live Kandle chart for crypto, stocks and forex, run indicator and strategy scripts, and set alerts.
long_description: Kandle is an open-source charting app that runs in the browser. This server connects to an open Kandle tab over a WebSocket on 127.0.0.1, after you pair it with a code and turn on the Agent bridge in the app. Open the app at https://kernel-hunter.github.io/kandle/ or run it locally.

tools.name: get_bridge_status
tools.description: Shows whether the Kandle app is connected and, if not, the pairing code the user must enter in Kandle (Agent button, then Agent bridge).

tools.name: get_chart_state
tools.description: Symbol, exchange, timeframe, last price, visible range, indicators with their latest values, drawings with ids, alerts, replay and layout state.

tools.name: set_symbol
tools.description: Switches the chart to another market, e.g. ETHUSDT on Binance or BTC-USD on Coinbase, or to a dataset the user imported from a CSV file (exchange csv).

tools.name: set_timeframe
tools.description: Changes the bar size of the chart.

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: OHLCV bars from the chart, newest last. Times are ISO 8601 UTC. Use include_indicators to get indicator values aligned with the bars.

tools.name: add_indicator
tools.description: Adds an indicator such as RSI, MACD, EMA, BOLL, ICHIMOKU or VP (volume profile). Returns its id.

tools.name: remove_indicator
tools.description: Removes an indicator by id, or every indicator with a name.

tools.name: list_indicators
tools.description: Indicators on the chart (with ids, parameters and latest values) and every indicator that can be added.

tools.name: draw
tools.description: Draws on the main chart by price and time: trend_line, horizontal_line, horizontal_ray, vertical_line, ray, extended_line, rectangle, fib (retracement from the first point to the second), text (a note at a point) or price_range. Returns the drawing id.

tools.name: remove_drawing
tools.description: Removes one drawing by id.

tools.name: clear_drawings
tools.description: Removes every drawing on the current symbol of the main chart.

tools.name: run_script
tools.description: Runs a Kandle script on the main chart and returns its id and latest plot values, or the error with line and column. request.security can read other symbols on the same source and other timeframes, including ones picked with input.symbol and input.timeframe. `inputs` sets input values by title and `id` replaces an earlier script; the result lists the input values. A script declared with strategy() is backtested on the loaded bars; the result then also has `backtest`: settings, summary (net profit, profit factor, win rate, max drawdown, Sharpe, buy and hold) and the last 20 trades. Orders fill at the next bar's open; limit and stop orders when the bar reaches their price.

tools.name: get_backtest
tools.description: Backtest results of a strategy script on the main chart: settings, summary figures, the latest closed trades with entry and exit time, price, signal and profit, and open trades. Results follow live data.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: PNG image of a chart pane, including indicators and drawings.

tools.name: set_alert
tools.description: Creates an alert on the main chart's symbol: price crossing or touching a level, price crossing a drawn horizontal or trend line, or an indicator line crossing a level. The app shows a notification, a toast and plays a sound when it fires.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: Every alert with its status.

tools.name: remove_alert
tools.description: Deletes an alert by id, or all alerts with "all".

tools.name: start_replay
tools.description: Hides bars after a start point so the chart can be replayed bar by bar. Indicators only see visible bars.

tools.name: step_replay
tools.description: Reveals the next bars in replay and returns them.

tools.name: stop_replay
tools.description: Leaves replay and returns the chart to live data.

tools.name: set_layout
tools.description: Shows 1, 2 (side by side) or 4 (grid) charts. Each pane has its own symbol, timeframe and indicators; crosshair, timeframe and symbol can be synced.
